comments.text:
Duckman's production company, Paramount Television, owned half of USA when the show premiered. The same year the show first aired, Viacom (eventually parodied on Duckman as Variecom in "How to Suck in Business Without Really Trying"), purchased Paramount.

This caused problems when Viacom launched TV Land, part of MTV Networks, in 1996. MCA, whose Universal Television unit owned the other half of USA, sued Viacom for breach of contract, as the owners of USA Networks weren't allowed to operate other basic cable channels outside the joint venture. This led Viacom to sell its half of USA and what is now Syfy to Universal in 1997.
